help.text:
usage: detect-secrets [-h] [-v] [--version] [-C <path>] [-c NUM_CORES]
                      {scan,audit} ...

positional arguments:
  {scan,audit}
    scan                Creates a baseline by scanning a repository for
                        secrets.
    audit               Manually assesses a baseline to determine validity of
                        secrets found.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -v, --verbose         Verbose mode.
  --version             Display version information.
  -C <path>             Run as if detect-secrets was started in <path>, rather
                        than in the current working directory.
  -c NUM_CORES, --cores NUM_CORES
                        Specify the number of cores to use for parallel
                        processing. Defaults to using the max cores on the
                        current host.

--all-files.help: Scan all files recursively (as compared to only scanning git tracked files).

--audit.help: Audit a given baseline file to distinguish the difference between false and true positives.

--bump.help: the bump type, specified as one of {major, minor, patch}

--cores.help: Specify the number of cores to use for parallel processing. Defaults to using the max cores on the current host.

--custom-plugins.help: Custom plugin Python files, or directories containing them. Directories are not searched recursively.

--diff.help: Allows the comparison of two baseline files, in order to effectively distinguish the difference between various plugin configurations.

--disable-plugin.help: Plugin class names to disable. e.g. Base64HighEntropyString

--display-results.help: Displays the results of an interactive auditing session which have been saved to a baseline file.

--exclude.help: Pass in regex to specify ignored paths during initialization scan.

--exclude-files.help: If filenames match this regex, it will be ignored.

--exclude-lines.help: If lines match this regex, it will be ignored.

--exclude-secrets.help: If secrets match this regex, it will be ignored.

--filter.help: Specify path to custom filter. May be a python module path (e.g. detect_secrets.filters.common.is_invalid_file) or a local file path (e.g. file://path/to/file.py::function_name).

--force-use-all-plugins.help: If a baseline is provided, detect-secrets will default to loading the plugins specified by that baseline. However, this may also mean it doesn't perform the scan with the latest plugins. If this flag is provided, it will always use the latest plugins

--gibberish-limit.help: Threshold to determine whether a string is gibberish.

--gibberish-model.help: Path to model trained with gibberish-detector.

--harakiri.help: Specifies an upper bound for the number of seconds to wait per execution.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--hide.help: Obfuscates the secret value in the display results function

--import.help: Import settings from previous existing baseline.

--keyword-exclude.help: Pass in regex to exclude false positives found by keyword detector.

--list-all-plugins.help: Lists all plugins that will be used for the scan.

--mode.help: Specifies the type of content to generate.

--no-verify.help: Disables additional verification of secrets via network call.

--num-iterations.help: Specifies the number of times to run the test. Results will be averaged over this value.

--only-allowlisted.help: Only scans the lines that are flagged with `allowlist secret`. This helps verify that individual exceptions are indeed non-secrets.

--only-false.help: Only includes false positives in the report

--only-real.help: Only includes real secrets in the report

--only-verified.help: Only flags secrets that can be verified.

--plugin.help: Specify path to custom secret detector plugin.

--report.help: Displays a report with the secrets detected

--scan.help: Scans the entire codebase and outputs a snapshot of currently identified secrets.

--slim.help: Slim baselines are created with the intention of minimizing differences between commits. However, they are not compatible with the `audit` functionality, and slim baselines will need to be remade to be audited.

--stats.help: Displays the results of an interactive auditing session which have been saved to a baseline file.

--string.help: Scans an individual string, and displays configured plugins' verdict.

--update.help: Update existing baseline by importing settings from it.

--use-all-plugins.help: Use all available plugins to scan files.

--word-list.help: Text file with a list of words, if a secret contains a word in the list we ignore it.

-C.help: Run as if detect-secrets was started in <path>, rather than in the current working directory.

audit.help: Manually assesses a baseline to determine validity of secrets found.

filename.help: Audit a given baseline file to distinguish the difference between false and true positives.

path.help: Scans the entire codebase and outputs a snapshot of currently identified secrets.

scan.help: Creates a baseline by scanning a repository for secrets.
